description: A photograph depicts a wide, calm water body, likely a lake or large pond, under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the immediate foreground, a line of several small, white rowing boats with red trim are moored along the shore. In the mid-ground, a larger white tour boat is visible, along with a few smaller paddle boats and human figures in the water. The far shore features a dense line of green trees, suggesting a vegetated bank. The image likely illustrates an urban or semi-urban recreational water feature, consistent with definitions for "Natural water bodies" in the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) documentation, including those of artificial origin in urban environments.
